description: This Java class implements a Liquibase custom change set to migrate drug order units to coded dose units within the OpenMRS database. It fetches unique unit values, maps them to concept IDs, and updates the drug_order table accordingly.

classes.name: MigrateDrugOrderUnitsToCodedDoseUnitsChangeset
classes.description: A Liquibase custom task to migrate drug order units to coded dose units in the database.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that performs the migration, updating 'drug_order' records with corresponding concept IDs based on units.

methods.name: migrateUnitsToCodedValue
methods.description: Performs the core logic of updating each unit to its corresponding concept ID, handling auto-commit and rollback.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions by rolling back the transaction and throwing a CustomChangeException.

methods.description: Returns a success message after completing the migration.
